hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom curve AMM hook for Euler Finance single-LP pools. In beforeSwap, it computes input/output amounts using a custom pricing curve, takes input tokens from the PoolManager into an Euler vault, and pays output tokens from another Euler vault—bypassing Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity entirely. Standard liquidity additions and donations are blocked via revert.
